title: Symbol Library — Software Profile
subtitle: Controlled shape vocabulary, profile SW-1.0
sheet_subheading: Shape denotes kind — dimension denotes magnitude — profile SW-1.0

explainer.heading: Rules of the vocabulary
paragraphs: Three encoding channels carry three independent facts. Shape carries kind. Height carries criticality. Footprint area carries scale or fan-out. A channel must carry one fact only. If height denotes kind, then height can no longer denote importance, and the drawing loses its strongest hierarchy signal.
notes: Shape is fixed by kind and must not be varied for emphasis. To distinguish two components of the same kind, vary height and footprint, never shape.
Height bands: 0.8 to 1.4 peripheral, 1.8 to 2.4 working, 2.8 to 3.5 load-bearing. A kind may render a different silhouette per band, as service does at band 3, but the kind does not change.
Hatch, accent and glow are reserved. Hatch denotes ownership. Accent denotes the critical path. Glow denotes the single authority. Do not spend these channels on decoration.
Every sheet must cite the profile and version in the title block. A drawing that does not cite its profile is not drawn to a standard.
